notes.title: Untitled Goose Game studio unpacks its new open world co-op game Big Walk, and it looks like nothing else I've played before
notes.notes: The team behind Untitled Goose Game announced Big Walk in late 2023, and even though its description was pretty straightforward—"a cooperative multiplayer adventure about teamwork and talking" —there's still a lot of mystery around it. What kind of teamwork will it require? Are there any goals? What are those weird wobbly spheric creatures, and can they honk?.. Read more.
